extracted.name: Easiest Teriyaki Marinade Ever
extracted.description: Pork chops and other meats taste great when marinated in this very simple but delicious teriyaki mixture.
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, mix water, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and cinnamon. Place desired meat in the mixture. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours before grilling as desired.
